strategy_objective_guidance:
- Single scored term: `combined_score = (dmin/dmax)^2 / (1/4.165849767)`. Only the squared ratio of minimum to maximum pairwise distance matters; no runtime, validity, or other bonus. Runtime is measured but not scored (only must not time out).
- Hard constraints: return a NumPy-array-convertible object of shape exactly (14, 3); dmax > 0 (otherwise score 0). Any exception → score 0, so robustness/fallback incumbents are score-critical, not cosmetic.
- No normalization constraint: scale/translation/rotation invariance means the problem is equivalent to maximizing dmin subject to dmax ≤ 1 (the evaluator's own reformulation: maximize t with d(i,j)² ≥ t, d(i,j)² ≤ 1). This is the classic "packing 14 points in a unit-diameter sphere" / best-packing problem in 3D.
- Benchmark squared ratio ≈ 0.24003; known best for 14 points in 3D is around dmin/dmax ≈ 0.5 (squared ≈ 0.25), so score ≈ 1.04 is achievable; the reference is near the true optimum, so gains are small — every 0.001 in squared ratio matters. The largest remaining lever is precise max-min packing optimization, not clever reformulation.
- No term rewards anything other than the nominal goal; the metric name vs. definition discrepancy (squared ratio) is irrelevant since it's monotone.

- Deterministic multistart local search: many seeded random normalizations (`np.random.default_rng(seed)`), normalize to dmax = 1, then run projected max-min ascent; keep global best. Mechanism: escapes poor local optima in the packing landscape.
- Constrained NLP via `scipy.optimize.minimize` (SLSQP or trust-constr) directly on the evaluator's reformulation: maximize t with variables (x_1..x_14, t), constraints d(i,j)² − t ≥ 0 and 1 − d(i,j)² ≥ 0 (91 + 91 constraints). `scipy.optimize.minimize(method='SLSQP')` with analytic Jacobians; trust-constr with `NonlinearConstraint` handles this scale well. Mechanism: directly optimizes the scored ratio.

Replacement scope: Replace the soft-min/soft-max surrogate objective and all L-BFGS-B calls in `min_max_dist_dim3_14()` with SLSQP on the exact reformulated problem; keep the grid-tuned cube+octa seed (and add the D6d seed from Strategy 1 if available) as starting points.

Select by exact squared ratio. strategies.title: [contact-graph-kkt] Active-set KKT polish of the incumbent contact graph
strategies.plan:
Mechanism family: active-set / contact-graph refinement
Replacement scope: Replace the final "Interleaved re-polish" block (the last soft_obj pass and the two perturbed SLSQP restarts) with an exact active-set Newton solve on the incumbent's contact graph.
Compute budget: One active-set solve, ≤40 Newton iterations, each a linear system of size ≤ (42 + |A|) with |A| ≤ ~30 active pairs; expected added evaluation time < 0.5 s.
Gain mechanism: At the optimum only O(n) pairs are at dmin and O(n) at dmax; the incumbent's soft-surrogate + SLSQP pipeline converges slowly near the kink, leaving measurable slack. Identify active pairs (d² ≤ dmin² + 1e-9) and diameter pairs (d² ≥ dmax² − 1e-9), fix scale so dmax² = 1, and solve the reduced KKT stationarity conditions (Lagrange multipliers on active constraints, coordinates of points in the active set as unknowns) by Newton with numerical Jacobian, projecting out the global rotation/translation nullspace. This is a new degree of freedom the incumbent lacks: it converges quadratically to the exact local optimum instead of linearly, and the incumbent's current 0.22596 squared ratio has typically 1e-4–1e-3 of slack from slow surrogate convergence at the same topology. Validity preserved: solve is a polish only; accept only if exact ratio improves, keep incumbent otherwise.
Expected-gain check: the new degree of freedom is quadratic (exact KKT) convergence on the *same* contact topology, which the incumbent's L-BFGS/SLSQP pipeline cannot achieve at its current tolerances; falsifiable threshold: final squared ratio must exceed 0.2259616 (combined_score > 0.9413) or the strategy is discarded.

Formulation: variables are the lower triangle of the centered Gram matrix G (rank ≤ 3, enforced softly by a penalty λ·(sum of eigenvalues 4..14)² with λ annealed 1e-2 → 1e6, eigenvalues via `np.linalg.eigvalsh` on the centered kernel), objective maximize t subject to G_ii + G_jj − 2G_ij ≥ t and ≤ 1 (these are exactly d_ij²), plus the rank penalty. Distances are recovered by eigendecomposition of the centered kernel (top-3 eigenvectors × sqrt(eigenvalues)), giving a valid (14,3) point set. At each annealing stage the recovered points are re-fed to the existing exact SLSQP reformulation, which is already implemented and reliable, so the Gram phase only needs to move the point into a slightly better basin. Hard validity: the final answer is always the incumbent `best_P` unless the Gram-phase output, after eigendecomposition recovery and the existing `slsqp_finish`, is finite and strictly improves `ratio(P)`; the recovery step is a projection onto exactly (14,3), and dmax > 0 is guaranteed by the existing normalize-by-dmax step.
Expected-gain check: the incumbent's active-set Newton leaves a measurable KKT residual (~1e-6 per its own docstring), and the Gram parametrization eliminates the null-space directions causing that stall; the falsifiable threshold is a final squared ratio strictly above the incumbent's 0.2400509 (combined_score > 1.0000159), with the new degrees of freedom being the 6 rotation/translation-free shape modes that coordinate-space solvers currently waste curvature on.

strategies.title: [sequential-linear-epigraph] First-order epigraph LP refinement of the incumbent
strategies.plan:
Mechanism family: sequential-linear-programming (successive LP trust-region on the max-min epigraph)
Replacement scope: Replace the final polish chain of `min_max_dist_dim3_14` — the `barrier_path` re-polish, the two perturbed SLSQP restarts, and the `active_set_newton` call — with a successive-linear-programming loop applied to the incumbent `best_P`. All earlier phases (seed ladder, SLSQP multistart, topology moves) are kept unchanged.
Compute budget: one LP loop, max 200 iterations, each LP solved with `scipy.optimize.linprog` (HiGHS) on ≤ 91 epigraph constraints plus a trust-region box ‖Δx‖∞ ≤ δ with δ annealed 1e-2 → 1e-9; expected evaluation time +0.3 s.
Gain mechanism: The incumbent stalls because SLSQP's line search and the LM Newton solve both leave a ~1e-6 KKT gap, and the exact min over 91 distances is nonsmooth at the active set. At each iterate, linearize d_ij²(x) exactly (its gradient is affine in x, so the linearization is exact up to the trust region) and solve max_{Δx,t} t s.t. d_ij²(x) + ∇d_ij²·Δx ≥ t, d_ij²(x) + ∇d_ij²·Δx ≤ 1, ‖Δx‖∞ ≤ δ. Because squared distances are quadratic, this is a second-order-exact model inside the trust region, so the LP handles the nonsmooth min directly without smoothing bias or line-search stalling; the incumbent's SLSQP/Newton machinery cannot take the piecewise-linear steepest-ascent direction that the LP identifies. Accept Δx only if the exact squared ratio improves; otherwise shrink δ ×0.5. Incumbent fallback: keep `best_P` if any LP fails. Validity: output renormalized to dmax = 1, shape (14,3) checked.
Expected-gain check: the LP epigraph step is a descent-ascent direction the incumbent's smooth solvers provably do not take at their stalled point (they stop at ftol/gtol while the LP uses the exact nonsmooth subgradient), so the falsifiable threshold is squared ratio strictly above the incumbent's 0.2400509 within ~1e-6–1e-5, i.e. combined_score > 1.000016.

strategies.title: [stress-majorization-uniform] SMACOF stress minimization to an all-equal target
strategies.plan:
Mechanism family: distance-geometry stress majorization (SMACOF) with a uniform target-distance matrix
Replacement scope: Replace the annealed-repulsion / log-barrier multistart block (`barrier_path` and its 6 starts) with a SMACOF block: from each of the existing polyhedral seeds plus the incumbent, run stress majorization toward the target matrix T_ij = 1 for all i≠j, then finish each trajectory with the existing `slsqp_finish`. The seed ladder and topology-move phases stay.
Compute budget: ≤ 12 SMACART starts, ≤ 300 Guttman transforms per start (each is an O(n²) matrix multiply, microseconds), then one 800-iteration SLSQP finish per surviving start; expected evaluation time roughly equal to the current ~3 s.
Gain mechanism: The stress objective S(x) = Σ_{i<j} (d_ij − 1)² has minimizer-agnostic gradient flow that pulls *every* pair toward equality, not just the currently active min/max pairs, so its trajectories cross max-min basin boundaries that repulsion (which only strengthens already-large distances) and barrier methods (which only shield the max pairs) cannot cross; it is a genuinely different vector field on the same configuration space, seeding SLSQP from contact graphs unreachable from the incumbent's basin. Implementation: standard SMACOF update x ← (1/n) Σ_j T_ij/d_ij (x_i − x_j) with a tiny diagonal loading to avoid d_ij = 0, run until stress change < 1e-12; renormalize dmax = 1 before the SLSQP finish; accept only if exact squared ratio beats the incumbent; keep `best_P` fallback on any exception. Validity: finite (14,3) array always returned, dmax > 0 after renormalization.
Expected-gain check: the new degree of freedom is the uniform-target stress flow, whose fixed points are configurations with all 91 distances equalized as far as 3D embedding permits — a basin the incumbent's repulsion/barrier fields cannot enter because their gradients vanish on the incumbent's active set; falsifiable threshold: squared ratio > 0.2400509 (combined_score > 1.000016) from at least one SMACOF-seeded SLSQP finish.

strategies.title: [covariance-adapted-global-search] Compact CMA-ES on the 42 coordinates with exa
strategies.plan:
Mechanism family: covariance-matrix-adaptation evolution strategy (CMA-ES) on the raw coordinate vector
Replacement scope: Replace the Gaussian-perturbation restart starts (the `0.03 * rng.randn` starts feeding `barrier_path` and the two final perturbed SLSQP restarts) with a single CMA-ES run on the 42-dimensional coordinate vector initialized at the incumbent, using the exact squared ratio as the (negative) fitness; keep the seed ladder, topology moves, and SLSQP machinery as-is and finish the CMA-ES best with `slsqp_finish`.

Gain mechanism: Isotropic Gaussian restarts sample spheres around the incumbent and relax back to the same contact graph (the parent's own diagnosis); CMA-ES adapts a full 42×42 covariance from the rank-based success distribution, so its search distribution elongates along the soft modes of the packing landscape (the directions along which the point set can deform while keeping dmin nearly constant) and crosses ridge-shaped basin separators that isotropic noise cannot. Implement CMA-ES from scratch (standard update equations, sigma0 = 0.05 after normalizing dmax = 1, deterministic seed, clip each candidate by renormalizing dmax = 1 before fitness evaluation so scale drift is impossible); after each 50 generations inject the incumbent if no improvement. Accept the CMA-ES output only after `slsqp_finish` and only if the exact squared ratio exceeds the incumbent; `best_P` remains the fallback on any exception.
